children: Japan's factory output rose 2.2% in September from the previous month, versus the median market forecast for a 1.3% rise, government data showed on Friday.
Manufacturers surveyed by the Ministry of Economy, Trade and Industry expect seasonally adjusted output to increase 5.1% in October and grow 0.8% in November.
